# Thanksgiving Table Decor Trends for 2026: 10 Elegant Ideas to Inspire Your Holiday Table

Aug 5, 2026

 

![A beautifully styled Thanksgiving dining table featuring handwoven placemats, ivory dinnerware, candles, seasonal pumpkins, pears, dried florals, and warm golden lighting.](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0507/2853/4205/files/Thanksgiving-Orchid-Napkin-Ring-Macondo-Forever-1696430688937.png?v=1696430690)

---

Thanksgiving is about much more than the meal.

It's a time to gather with family, reconnect with friends, and create memories around the table. While the menu is important, the table itself sets the tone for the entire celebration.

In 2026, Thanksgiving decorating is moving away from overly themed displays and embracing a more refined, timeless style. Homeowners are choosing natural materials, warm color palettes, and handcrafted pieces that feel inviting, elegant, and meaningful.

Whether you're hosting your first Thanksgiving dinner or continuing a family tradition, these decorating trends will help you create a table your guests will remember long after dessert is served.

---

# Trend #1: Natural Woven Textures Take Center Stage

Natural materials continue to dominate home décor, and Thanksgiving is the perfect season to embrace them.

Handwoven placemats, baskets, trays, and candle holders add warmth and texture that beautifully complement the rich colors of autumn.

Instead of relying on disposable decorations, many hosts are investing in handcrafted pieces they can enjoy year after year.

Natural woven décor pairs effortlessly with pumpkins, candles, seasonal greenery, and heirloom dinnerware, creating a timeless look that never feels trendy.

[![Close-up of handwoven Iraca placemats layered beneath ivory dinner plates with brass flatware.](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0507/2853/4205/files/ThanksgivingTable2022.1.png?v=1694801277)](https://macondoforever.com/collections/placemats)

[Handwoven Placemats Collection](https://macondoforever.com/collections/placemats)

---

# Trend #2: Warm Earth Tones Replace Traditional Orange

While classic orange pumpkins remain a Thanksgiving favorite, today's tables are embracing a softer palette inspired by nature.

Popular colors for 2026 include:

* Warm ivory
* Camel
* Olive green
* Terracotta
* Cinnamon
* Deep burgundy
* Soft gold
* Natural woven tones

These colors create a sophisticated table that feels both cozy and elegant.

---

# Trend #3: Layered Place Settings

One of the easiest ways to make your Thanksgiving table feel luxurious is through layering.

Start with:

* Handwoven placemat
* Charger plate
* Dinner plate
* Salad plate
* Linen napkin
* Decorative napkin ring

Adding multiple layers creates depth and gives each place setting a thoughtfully curated look.

---

![Napkin Rings Collection](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0507/2853/4205/files/Fall_metallic_table_settings.jpg?v=1751558898)

Layered Thanksgiving place setting featuring woven placemats, linen napkins, and ceramic dinnerware.

[Napkin Rings Collection](https://macondoforever.com/collections/napkin-rings)

---

# Trend #4: Centerpieces Inspired by Nature

Oversized floral arrangements are giving way to simpler, more organic centerpieces.

This year's favorite centerpiece ideas include:

* White pumpkins
* Pears
* Figs
* Pomegranates
* Candles
* Eucalyptus
* Olive branches
* Dried grasses

A handwoven basket filled with seasonal produce creates a centerpiece that is both beautiful and functional.

![Handwoven basket centerpiece filled with pumpkins, pears, eucalyptus, and candles.](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0507/2853/4205/files/Strenvase.jpg?v=1717523552)

[Handwoven Basket Collection](https://macondoforever.com/collections/personal-mini-bread-basket)

---

# Trend #5: Handmade Details That Tell a Story

Today's hosts are choosing décor with meaning.

Handmade pieces bring character, authenticity, and craftsmanship to the table.

Each Macondo Forever piece is handwoven by artisan families in Usiacurí, Colombia using traditional techniques passed down through generations.

These details become conversation starters and often become treasured holiday traditions themselves.

---

# Trend #6: Candlelight Creates a Warm Atmosphere

Lighting can completely transform a Thanksgiving dinner.

Layer different heights of candles throughout the table to create warmth and intimacy.

Mix:

* Taper candles
* Pillar candles
* Hurricane lanterns
* Tea lights

The soft glow encourages guests to relax, linger, and enjoy the evening together.

![Thanksgiving table illuminated by candlelight during dinner.](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0507/2853/4205/files/candle_holders.jpg?v=1695139279)

# Trend #7: Mix Family Heirlooms with New Pieces

One of the most beautiful decorating trends is blending old and new.

Pair grandmother's china with handcrafted placemats.

Use vintage serving bowls alongside modern woven trays.

This layered approach gives your table personality and tells your family's story.

---

# Trend #8: Elegant Simplicity

The biggest decorating trend for Thanksgiving 2026 is restraint.

Rather than filling every inch of the table with decorations, focus on a few high-quality pieces that allow guests—and the meal—to remain the center of attention.

Natural textures, neutral colors, and handcrafted details create a table that feels timeless instead of trendy.

---

![Elegant finished Thanksgiving tablescape featuring woven décor, candles, pumpkins, and seasonal greenery.](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0507/2853/4205/files/Minimalist_Thanksgiving_Table_Setting.jpg?v=1730843592)

# Create a Thanksgiving Table That Guests Will Remember

A beautiful Thanksgiving table isn't about perfection.

It's about creating an atmosphere where loved ones feel welcome.

By combining natural textures, warm seasonal colors, handcrafted décor, and thoughtful details, you can create a gathering that celebrates gratitude, connection, and tradition.

At Macondo Forever, every handwoven piece is made to help transform everyday moments into meaningful celebrations.

Whether you're hosting a large family feast or an intimate dinner, our handcrafted collections are designed to become part of your holiday traditions for years to come.

You'll learn to master the 2026 palette of sage green and deep jewel tones, creating a cohesive look that impresses every guest. * Learn the tactile benefits of premium linen and why natural materials outshine synthetic options.
* Master the professional measurement rules for **thanksgiving table runners** to achieve a perfect, balanced overhang.

## The Essential Role of Thanksgiving Table Runners in Holiday Hosting

Think of your dining surface as a canvas and the table runner as the bold stroke that defines the entire composition. In modern holiday design, **thanksgiving table runners** act as the visual anchor for the feast. They provide an intentional path for the eye to follow, grounding your centerpieces, vases, and serving platters. This structural element helps resolve the common "curated vs. cluttered" debate. Instead of decor items floating aimlessly across a vast table, a runner creates a dedicated zone for your creative expression. It adds vital texture and warmth without overwhelming the room. You want a sophisticated atmosphere that still feels approachable. A runner achieves this balance perfectly by softening hard surfaces while offering practical protection against heat and unexpected spills.

### Why Choose a Runner Over a Full Tablecloth?

If you've invested in a beautiful walnut, oak, or quartz dining table, don't feel obligated to hide it. A runner allows the natural grain and character of your furniture to shine. This creates a modern, less formal environment compared to traditional, heavy tablecloths. It's a style choice that feels fresh, airy, and intentional. Beyond the aesthetics, the logistics are far more manageable for a busy host. High-quality **thanksgiving table runners** are easier to launder, press, and store than bulky, large-scale linens. This efficiency is a game changer when you're managing a complex holiday schedule and want to focus on your guests rather than your laundry room.

### Setting the Mood for Your 2026 Gathering

Your choice of fabric and color sets the psychological stage for the day. A crisp, neutral runner signals a clean, minimalist aesthetic, while a heavy weave suggests a rustic and cozy vibe. For 2026, we see a distinct move toward [premium materials like linen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linen) that offer a timeless, artisanal feel. A well-set table does more than look good; it signals to your guests that the event is significant. This attention to detail immediately increases guest comfort and anticipation. As the natural light fades, the runner helps transition the mood. Under the glow of candlelight, the specific texture of the fabric becomes more pronounced. This shifts the energy from a casual family lunch to an elegant evening celebration. It's the simplest way to elevate your hosting experience while maintaining a sense of curated simplicity.

## Selecting Premium Materials: Linen, Cotton, and Beyond

The tactile quality of your table setting determines how guests feel the moment they sit down. Material choice is the most critical decision you'll make when curating your holiday aesthetic. It's the difference between a functional cover and a design statement. While budget synthetic options might look acceptable in a package, they often lack the substantial weight and graceful "drape" required for a professional look. Premium **thanksgiving table runners** should feel substantial to the touch and hang with a purposeful, heavy elegance over the table edge. This weight ensures the fabric stays in place throughout the meal, even as platters are passed and glasses are refilled.

### The Timeless Appeal of Linen Runners

Linen remains the gold standard for a reason. It offers a unique, slubbed texture that catches the warm flicker of candlelight in a way that flat, man-made fibers simply cannot. This material is incredibly durable. A high-quality linen piece is a multi-year investment that actually softens and improves with every wash. If you're looking for that perfect blend of rustic charm and high-end sophistication, linen is your best ally. It brings an organic, worldly feel to the dining room that resonates with the spirit of the season. Its natural breathability and strength mean it won't pill or thin out over time, unlike cheaper alternatives.

### Cotton and Blends for Versatile Style

High-density cotton is an excellent choice for hosts who prefer a crisp, tailored appearance. It provides a smooth surface that acts as a clean backdrop for intricate flatware or colorful centerpieces. Look for weaves that offer a subtle sheen under your dining room lighting. This adds a layer of quiet luxury without being overly reflective. Many cotton **thanksgiving table runners** feature delicate embroidered details, adding a touch of seasonal craftsmanship that feels personal and warm. These blends often offer a bit more structure, which is ideal if you want sharp, clean lines at the end of your table.

Maintenance shouldn't be a deterrent to choosing quality. Modern holiday hosting is about ease. Many premium linens are designed to be machine-washed and look stunning with their natural, soft-washed texture. You don't always need a perfectly pressed surface to achieve a sophisticated look. Often, the slight, natural undulations of real fabric add to the welcoming, lived-in atmosphere of a family gathering. ## Mastering Proportions: Sizing Your Runner for Any Table

Scale is the silent partner in great design. If your runner is too short, it looks like an afterthought. If it's too long, it becomes a tripping hazard or crowds the guest's lap. For a classic, professional look, aim for an overhang of 6 to 10 inches on each side. This provides enough fabric to signal luxury without interfering with seating comfort. It's a small detail that makes a massive impact on the overall symmetry of your room.

Measure your table length carefully before you start shopping. Add 12 to 20 inches to that total to find your ideal runner length. If you're leaning toward a contemporary aesthetic, consider the "short runner" trend. In this style, the fabric stops about 4 inches before the table edge on both sides. This centered look keeps the focus entirely on your centerpiece and works beautifully on modern, minimalist surfaces. It's a clean approach that highlights the craftsmanship of your table while providing a crisp foundation for **thanksgiving table runners**.

### Styling Round and Square Tables

Square and round tables often baffle hosts who are used to rectangular layouts. A single runner can sometimes feel visually thin in these spaces. Try the "X" technique instead. Place two identical runners perpendicular to each other to create a cross shape. This anchors the center of the table while providing a balanced backdrop for every guest's place setting. For a small round table, one centered runner can actually elongate the room by drawing the eye across the diameter. It's a simple yet effective trick for [Mastering the Art of Stunning Table Scapes](https://tableterrain.com/blogs/art-of-tablescapes/mastering-the-art-of-stunning-table-scapes-a-2026-guide-to-elegant-hosting) in tighter quarters. Focus on maintaining visual balance by keeping your centerpiece low and contained within the runner's width.

### Proportions for Large Family Gatherings

Thanksgiving often means adding every available leaf to the dining table. If your table expands, your linens must follow suit. For extra-long banquet tables, don't stress about finding a single, impossible 20-foot piece. Instead, overlap two identical **thanksgiving table runners**. You can easily hide the seam under a substantial floral arrangement or a lush greenery garland. Width also plays a critical role in guest comfort. A standard runner is usually 12 to 14 inches wide. Ensure your choice leaves at least 15 inches of clear space on either side for dinner plates, flatware, and glassware. This prevents the fabric from tangling with place settings and keeps the layout feeling organized and airy. Harmony comes from giving every element its own breathing room.

## 2026 Design Trends: Layering Color, Glassware, and Greenery

Modern holiday tablescapes in 2026 are moving away from literal harvest motifs toward a more atmospheric, tonal approach. The current palette embraces sophisticated sage green, moody plum, and warm metallic accents that reflect the soft autumn light. Your **thanksgiving table runners** serve as the canvas for these deeper hues. By selecting a runner in a muted charcoal or deep forest tone, you create a high-contrast foundation that allows your accessories to pop. This year is all about intentional depth. You aren't just setting a table; you're building a sensory environment that feels both grounded and luxurious.

### Coordinating with Glassware and Flatware

Lighting plays a vital role in how your table feels. The matte texture of a linen runner provides a beautiful counterpoint to the high-shine finish of premium flatware. You can pull specific colors from your textiles by using colored glassware. For instance, coordinating your runner with [green goblets](https://tableterrain.com/blogs/art-of-tablescapes/the-green-goblet-buying-guide-styling-a-timeless-tablescape-in-2026) creates a monochromatic depth that feels professionally styled. This harmony extends to every detail. For a deep dive into matching your fabrics with hardware, check out [The Ultimate Guide to Table Linens and Napkin Rings](https://tableterrain.com/blogs/art-of-tablescapes/the-ultimate-guide-to-table-linens-and-napkin-rings-elevate-your-hosting). Layering doesn't stop at the runner. Placing textured placemats on top of the fabric adds a three-dimensional quality that prevents the table from looking flat or "one-note."

### Centerpiece Integration Strategies

A successful centerpiece shouldn't compete with your guests' sightlines. On a runner foundation, low-profile arrangements of eucalyptus, dried florals, or acorns create a natural visual flow. These elements bridge the gap between the fabric and the place settings. If you prefer height, use slender vases and containers to keep the footprint small. This ensures the runner remains visible rather than being completely obscured by decor. The goal is to guide the eye from the center of the table toward the individual place settings. This intentional movement creates a sense of unity across the entire surface. You can achieve this by weaving sprigs of greenery along the edges of your **thanksgiving table runners**, softening the transition from fabric to wood. It creates a lush, organic border that feels curated yet effortless. Ready to build your own signature look? ## Frequently Asked Questions

### Should a Thanksgiving table runner hang over the edge?

Your runner should ideally hang 6 to 10 inches over each edge of your table. This length provides a balanced, professional look that doesn't interfere with your guests' seating comfort. If you prefer a contemporary feel, choose a shorter runner that ends just before the table edge. This centered style highlights your table's material while anchoring your holiday centerpiece. Always measure your table length before purchasing to ensure a perfect, tailored fit.

### Can I use a table runner on a round table for Thanksgiving?

Absolutely use a table runner on a round table to create visual interest. A single runner centered across the diameter provides a clean foundation for a floral centerpiece. For a more formal look, place two runners perpendicularly to anchor the table's center. This technique works well for smaller dining areas where you want to maximize the impact of your **thanksgiving table runners** without crowding the surface. It adds a layer of curated sophistication.

### What is the best fabric for a holiday table runner?

Linen is the gold standard for holiday runners due to its durability and natural texture. It offers a sophisticated, matte finish that catches candlelight beautifully, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. While high-density cotton provides a crisp, clean look, linen actually improves with every wash and lasts for years. Its substantial weight ensures the fabric drapes elegantly over the table edge, signaling a high-end, curated experience for your family and guests.

### How wide should a table runner be for a standard dining table?

A standard runner is typically 12 to 14 inches wide for most dining tables. This width provides enough room for centerpieces and candles while leaving at least 15 inches of space on either side for place settings. You don't want a runner that's too wide, as it can crowd your glassware and flatware. Maintaining these proportions ensures your tablescape feels organized and airy. It allows every design element to have its own breathing room.

### How do I clean a linen table runner after a holiday meal?

Clean your linen runner by spot-treating spills immediately with a mild detergent. Most high-quality linens are machine-washable on a gentle cycle with cool water. Don't use bleach or harsh chemicals that can damage the fibers. You can air dry the runner or tumble dry it on low heat to achieve a soft, natural texture. Many hosts prefer the slightly lived-in look of unpressed linen for a relaxed yet sophisticated holiday vibe that feels approachable.

### Can I layer a table runner over a tablecloth?

Layering a runner over a tablecloth is a brilliant way to add depth and dimension to your setting. This technique allows you to mix different textures, such as a crisp cotton tablecloth paired with a heavy linen runner. It provides a formal, curated look that feels intentional and professionally styled. Just ensure the colors complement each other to maintain aesthetic harmony. It's the perfect approach for creating a lush, multi-dimensional tablescape that truly impresses.

### What are the most popular colors for Thanksgiving 2026?

Popular colors for 2026 move away from traditional orange toward "New Neutrals" like sage green, champagne, and muted charcoal. Sophisticated tablescapes also incorporate deep jewel tones like moody plum and burgundy for added drama. These earthy, warm tones reflect a shift toward a more organic and curated aesthetic. Using these hues in your **thanksgiving table runners** creates a modern foundation that pairs beautifully with natural greenery, acorns, and warm metallic accents.

### How do I choose a runner that matches my existing glassware?

Match your runner to your glassware by coordinating colors or contrasting textures. If you have colored goblets or wine glasses, choose a runner in a neutral tone like charcoal or cream to make the glass pop. Alternatively, a runner with a subtle pattern can pull out specific hues from your glassware for a cohesive look. Pay attention to the finish; the matte texture of linen provides a stunning counterpoint to the high-shine surface of premium glass.

# Our favorite Advent calendars are rolling out. Here are 32 to grab now

![Advent calendars set against a Christmas background](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/advent-calendars-group-cnnu.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_833,w_1480,c_fill)

## Our featured picks

#### To spice up their meals

### [Fly By Jing 2026 Limited-Edition 12-Day Advent Calendar](https://www.awin1.com/cread.php?awinmid=61391&awinaffid=1305685&campaign=&clickref=090225adventcalendars&clickref2=&clickref3=&clickref4=&clickref5=&clickref6=&ued=https%3A%2F%2Fflybyjing.com%2Fproducts%2Fadvent-calendar&platform=pl)

#### For the wine aficionado

### [In Good Taste 2026 Wine Advent Calendar](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87732X1565017&url=https%3A%2F%2Fingoodtaste.com%2Fproducts%2Fwine-advent-calendar&xcust=090225adventcalendars)

![green and red Advent calendar](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/in-good-taste-2026-advent-calendar.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

#### For the skin care and fragrance enthusiast

### [Anthropologie The 24 Days of Beauty 2026 Advent Calendar](https://ncls1.com/irk?s=769621&o=sxjd55&subid=cnn.com&bkd=anthropologie.com&d=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.anthropologie.com%2Fshop%2Fthe-24-days-of-beauty-advent-calendar2&arid=090225adventcalendars)

![fuchsia Advent calendar of beauty products](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/anthropologie-24-beauty-2026-advent-calendar.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

#### A highly coveted crowdpleaser

### [Bonne Maman 2026 Limited-Edition Advent Calendar](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08D98XBX8?tag=Underscoreddefault-20&ascsubtag=090225adventcalendars)

![red and white Advent calendar with jars of jam](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/bonne-maman-2026-advent-calendar.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

[Read our review](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/bonne-maman-advent-calendar-2026)

The winter holidays are still weeks away, but you don’t want to wait until the season becomes chaotic to check out all the cool gifts already available. As [gift guide editors](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/best-gifts), we believe it’s never too early to indulge in a little pre-Christmas countdown, and we’re continuing to see many of our favorite Advent calendars roll out early.

Plus, Advent calendars make some of the best [personalized holiday gifts](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/personalized-gifts) for loved ones because there are so many different kinds to choose from, regardless of whether you’re shopping for a friend with a [major sweet tooth](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/best-chocolate-advent-calendars), someone who [enjoys pampering themselves](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/best-self-care-gifts) or the biggest [Star Wars fan](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/best-star-wars-gifts) you know. No matter your gift budget and recipient, you’re bound to find a 12- or 24-day calendar on this list that’ll bring some cheer to your giftee’s holiday season and serve almost as a [temporary hobby](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/home/editor-favorite-hobbies-games-crafts).

Every year, we track the release of our favorite brands’ calendars in order to put them on your radar ASAP, including [chocolate Advent calendars](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/best-chocolate-advent-calendars), wine Advent calendars and even [dog Advent calendars](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/best-dog-advent-calendars). Many of them sell out before winter even arrives, so if you see one here that catches your eye, don’t wait too long to buy it. Though it might not feel like it right now, Dec. 1 will be here before you know it, and there’s nothing like a fun surprise every day to make the [lead-up to Christmas](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/best-christmas-gift-ideas) that much more joyful.

## Our favorite Advent calendars

### [Bonne Maman 2026 Limited-Edition Advent Calendar](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08D98XBX8?tag=Underscoreddefault-20&ascsubtag=090225adventcalendars)

![red and white Advent calendar with jars of jam](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/bonne-maman-2026-advent-calendar.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

This year, Bonne Maman unveiled its annual Advent calendar in July, and to no one’s surprise, our readers went wild for it from the get-go. Patel is also a fan, making sure to [try the new calendar](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/bonne-maman-advent-calendar-2026) as soon as it’s out every year. This time around, it has enticing limited-edition fruit preserves flavors you don’t want to miss, such as Strawberry with Madagascar Vanilla and Mango with Ylang-Ylang. At $56, the 10th anniversary calendar is also a terrific value considering you get 24 mini jars of jam to try.

### [Laneige 12 Days of Wonder Advent Calendar](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87732X1565017&url=https%3A%2F%2Fus.laneige.com%2Fproducts%2Fadvent-calendar&xcust=090225adventcalendars)

![Laneige 12 Days of Wonder Advent Calendar](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/screenshot-2026-10-09-at-1-22-21-pm.png?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

Laneige’s viral [Lip Sleeping Mask](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/reviews/laneige-vs-w7-lip-mask) is not only a favorite among our editors but, more generally, one of the top beauty products of the decade. So, if you know anyone who’s always trying out the latest trends in skin care, gift them the brand’s Advent calendar. It features other lip and skin care products in addition to the lip mask, including tinted lip serums, a hydrating gel cleanser and a skin-firming serum.

### [Galison 12 Days of Puzzles 'Winter Lights' Christmas Countdown Advent Calendar](https://www.amazon.com/dp/0735378789/?tag=Underscoreddefault-20&ascsubtag=090225adventcalendars)

![multicolored puzzle Advent calendar](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/joy-laforme-winter-lights-12-days-of-puzzles.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

Slatinska owns [jigsaw puzzles](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/home/jigsaw-puzzling) from Galison and enjoys assembling them when she’s in the mood for a relaxing, [screen-free hobby](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/home/editor-favorite-hobbies-games-crafts). With this Advent calendar from the brand, you get 12 mini puzzles (80 pieces each) to put together, all illustrated with festive winter scenes to help get you in the holiday spirit.

### [SmartBones Furry Christmas Advent Calendar](https://www.amazon.com/SmartBones-SBM-00489H-SmartBones®-Holiday-Calendar/dp/B097FCQ1MK?th=1&linkCode=ll1&tag=Underscoreddefault-20&linkId=b75bc6ec9c662e5eb6afa08bb828c0b8&language=en_US&ref_=as_li_ss_tl&ascsubtag=090225adventcalendars)

![SmartBones Furry Christmas Advent Calendar](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/underscored-smart-bones-holiday-advent-calendar.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

Even though this Advent calendar for small dogs isn’t new for this year, it’s a favorite of our editorial coordinator [Stephanie Luna](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/about/stephanie-luna)’s pup. “My dog, Stitch, is usually a picky eater, but he loved the treats in this calendar,” she said. “Since the treats are quite chewy, they kept him entertained for a few minutes, and once he finished eating, he started rubbing his face against the couch, his telltale sign that he just ate something delicious!”

Murray’s Cheese is one of our top-recommended brands for [gift baskets](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/best-gift-baskets), and every year, the brand releases an Advent calendar we immensely look forward to trying. The 2026 calendar features a new and exclusive design for the holidays and comes with fan-favorite cheese varieties, not to mention other snacks like jam, honey and crackers.

### [Anthropologie The 24 Days of Beauty 2026 Advent Calendar](https://ncls1.com/irk?s=769621&o=sxjd55&subid=cnn.com&bkd=anthropologie.com&d=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.anthropologie.com%2Fshop%2Fthe-24-days-of-beauty-advent-calendar2&arid=090225adventcalendars)

![fuchsia Advent calendar of beauty products](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/anthropologie-24-beauty-2026-advent-calendar.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

Anthropologie’s fan-favorite beauty Advent calendar is back and features $300 worth of [makeup](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/beauty/makeup), [fragrances](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/beauty/fragrance) and [skin care products](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/beauty/skin-care) from top brands. CNN Underscored associate home and gifts editor [Nikol Slatinska](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/about/nikol-slatinska) had a blast testing the calendar with her mom, who similarly loves all things beauty. From a brightening Caudalíe [eye cream](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/reviews/best-eye-cream-for-mature-skin) to a lovely skin-scent perfume by Juliette Has A Gun, the items inside this gorgeous box are so exciting to discover. It’s almost impossible to believe you can get the entire calendar for under $100.

### [Uncommon Goods 12 Days of Hot Sauce Advent Calendar](https://ncls1.com/irk?s=769621&o=sxjd55&subid=cnn.com&bkd=uncommongoods.com&d=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.uncommongoods.com%2Fproduct%2F12-days-of-hot-sauce-advent&arid=090225adventcalendars)

![Uncommon Goods 12 Days of Hot Sauce Advent](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/uncommon-goods-12-days-of-hot-sauce-advent-cnnu.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

CNN Underscored home and gifts editor [Amina Lake Patel](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/about/amina-lake-patel) recently tried and enjoyed this one from Uncommon Goods, which features 12 mini bottles of Torchbearer Sauces. Some of the included flavors were even [featured on the show "Hot Ones,"](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87732X1565017&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.torchbearersauces.com%2Fcollections%2Fhot-ones%2Fproducts%2Fhot-ones-collection-by-torchbearer-sauces&xcust=090225adventcalendars) but Patel's favorite so far is the Psycho Curry.

### [Tea Forté Volaré 12-Day Advent Calendar](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87732X1565017&url=https%3A%2F%2Fteaforte.com%2Fproducts%2Fgourmet-tea-volare-collection-advent-12-days-of-blissful-teas-112990&xcust=090225adventcalendars)

![triangular blue tea Advent calendar](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/tea-forte-volare-advent-calendar.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

Made in collaboration with the New York Botanical Garden, the calendar boasts a distinct, display-worthy design that’ll instantly dress up your tea or coffee bar. It’s the perfect [cozy gift](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/gifts/best-cozy-gifts) for any tea drinker in your life.

For $20, the brand also has a [this tea Advent calendar](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GSQQT95R/?tag=Underscoreddefault-20&ascsubtag=090225adventcalendars) that arrives in a ready-to-hang folder.

### [Voluspa 12-Day Alpine Advent Calendar](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87732X1565017&url=https%3A%2F%2Fvoluspa.com%2Fproducts%2Fadvent-calendar-assorted-gift-set&xcust=090225adventcalendars)

Slatinska is a longtime fan of the brand and burns a new candle from this calendar in her home every week. The calendar also comes with a gold wick trimmer. Pro tip: Always trim wicks before each burn to make candles last longer!

### [Craftspring Nutcracker Minis Advent Calendar](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87732X1565017&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.craftspring.com%2Fproducts%2Fnutcracker-minis-advent-calendar&xcust=090225adventcalendars)

![red Nutcracker-themed Advent calendar](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/craftspring-nutcracker-advent-calendar.jpg?c=16x9&q=h_720,w_1280,c_fill)

This one is Nutcracker-themed and comes with 24 of the small trinkets to hang on your tree and around your home. Patel received the calendar and said each ornament feels high-quality. “I love that they're handmade, which helps justify the price a bit,” she said. “I got the Nutcracker version because I love the classic ballet theme, but they all seem equally adorable. Plus, it all comes packaged in a dazzling red chest that any beauty aficionado would be thrilled to receive.

## How to choose the best Advent calendar

Choosing an Advent calendar is as easy as picking one out that suits your (or the recipient’s) interests. If you’ve got a major sweet tooth, then you’ll probably be drawn to one of the chocolate or candy Advent calendars on this list. If you’re shopping for someone who’s looking to pick up a new [screen-free hobby](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/home/editor-favorite-hobbies-games-crafts), a [Woobles crochet kit Advent calendar](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87732X1565017&url=https%3A%2F%2Fthewoobles.com%2Fproducts%2Fhere-we-go-a-wooblin-advent-calendar&xcust=090225adventcalendars) might be the perfect gift they’d never think to get themselves.

You should also look at whether the Advent calendar has 24 or 12 days’ worth of surprises so you can set your expectations. If you start your countdown on Dec. 1 but don’t have enough items to get you to Christmas Eve, you’ll probably be left disappointed. Similarly, it’s a good idea to consider the overall value of an Advent calendar. If you don’t care about spoilers, take a look at the list of products included and see how many are miniature versus full size. This will help you determine if the cost of the calendar is worth it to you. Even if you’re not getting the [best deal](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/deals) out there, an Advent calendar could be worth buying because of the novelty factor.

## FAQs

### What is an Advent calendar used for?

Advent calendars are designed to count down the days until Christmas, so they typically have 24 or 25 openings filled with treats or small surprises. In that case, you’d open the first one on Dec. 1 so you can spread the holiday cheer throughout the beginning of the month.

Other Advent calendars have only 12 days (for the 12 days of Christmas), which means you open the first door on Christmas Day. However, some people choose to start those 12-day countdowns on Dec. 13 instead. We’ve done it both ways, so the choice is yours!

By Mari Uyehara and Samantha Schoech

Advent calendars began as a Christian tradition in the 19th century and have grown to be part of secular holiday fun as well. In the weeks leading up to Christmas, they provide a daily delight.

We tested and tasted our way through a bunch of Advent calendars (somebody had to) and gathered some of our favorites for kids and adults, including an annually anticipated beauty calendar, our favorite Lego versions, a spicy sauce and snack collection, and many more.

Many of our picks are from companies and makers that we have already vetted in their respective categories. Check out the best teas we’ve tasted, the best boxed chocolates, and the best Lego sets for kids for year-round excellence.

## Edible (and drinkable) calendars

### Bokksu Advent Calendar

The 24 drawers in this gorgeously made Advent calendar hold a world of Japanese treasures: 17 kinds of sweets and snacks, plus seven little collectibles.

A legit stunner, the Bokksu Luminous Japan Advent Calendar is revealed when you open two doors with translucent blue window panels sandwiched by paper lantern cutouts. In 17 of the 24 drawers are delectable treats, many of them multiple: matcha KitKats, orange gummies, hojicha chocolate crunch, savory crackers, and more. And the remaining seven contain things you can (and will want to) keep — a patterned cloth, a small ceramic piece, and so forth. We had assumed that this pricey, sophisticated set might appeal most to adults, but when we let one Japanophile tween at it, he tore through every single box in near ecstasy, which convinced us that it’s a winner for families, as well. Though we still recommend opening one drawer daily, we can report that, unlike many Advent calendars, the Bokksu version contains unique surprises that don’t get repetitive and continue to thrill right to the last one.

### Murray’s Cheese Countdown Calendar

The New York–based cheese company showcases 12 days of crowd-pleasing dairy delights and accoutrements, such as fruit spreads and crackers, in an adorably illustrated box.

A savory counterpoint to legions of sweet Advent calendars, the 12 Days Of Murray’s Cheese Countdown Calendar has plenty of good stuff for those who choose the cheese plate over dessert. At first glance, our kitchen team thought the selections could be more deep-cut, but once they started tasting, they were surprised by how good many of the crowd-pleasing classics were and how much they enjoyed them. Take the pepper jack: Normally a simple supermarket offering, the Murray’s version was extra creamy with a pervasively verdant jalapeño flavor and a lovely, sweet finish. “I’m still thinking about that one,” admitted kitchen editor and new convert Marilyn Ong. “I was really taken aback by its deliciousness.” Just note: The calendar does sell out each year, and since the box contains perishable products, it ships with ice packs and must be refrigerated upon arrival.

### See’s Candies Advent Calendar

See’s Chocolates are a California institution, and this many-drawered Advent calendar gives candy lovers far and wide a chance to sample 24 different treats, including the company’s famed lollipops.

“This 102-year-old company nails delicious nostalgia, especially at the holidays. Though if you’re Californian, I probably don’t need to sell you on the appeal of digging through one of See’s famous assortment boxes for dark chocolate scotchmallows,” said writer Rachel Wharton. See’s Candies doesn’t use any preservatives in its confections, so you know each bite is going to be fresh and delicious. We love the mix of foil-wrapped solid milk chocolates, filled chocolates, and its famous lollipops, all of which are included in the snowy brick-facade setting of this calendar.

### Fly By Jing Advent Calendar

The 12-day Advent calendar contains a surprise collection of 2-ounce jars of condiments, spices, and sauces, plus noodles and snacks, all inspired by the flavors of Sichuan and all vegan.

The 12-day Fly By Jing 2026 Advent Calendar offers a chance to taste a dozen tingly products inspired by China’s Sichuan province. This year’s selection includes some of the company’s best-selling chili crisps, as well as noodles, a hot sauce, and a new hot honey (“really yummy,” according to our kitchen team). One bummer from our testing this year: The included ornament was broken when we opened it. And be sure to order early — last year the limited-edition calendar sold out by November 15.

### Bonne Maman Advent Calendar 2026 Edition

The 24 doors in Bonne Maman’s Advent calendar house classic (four fruits, mixed berry) and exclusive spreads, jams, and honeys in darling mini jars.

Why not spread the love? Get a Bonne Maman Advent Calendar for yourself, and send others to friends and family. When the 24 adorably tiny jars are empty, you can use them to save leftover condiments, bring spices on a camping trip, display a single flower bud, store leftover paint and sequins, or stock a play kitchen.

### Adagio Teas Advent Calendar

Available in versions with loose tea or tea bags, this Adagio calendar offers novel, yuletide blends for each day leading up to Christmas.

The tea obsessives on our staff have sung the praises of family-owned Adagio Teas’s Silver Needle white tea in our best teas guide. And the Adagio Teas Nutcracker Advent Calendar gives heavy tea drinkers and casual sippers alike a chance to try new holiday flavors, such as Pomegranate Grove and Candy Cane. The calendar comes in loose-leaf, tea-bag, and decaf versions, and there are clear directions (with brew temp and time) right on the package, so you don’t ruin your cuppa.

### McCrea’s Caramel 2026 Advent Calendar

Behind each paper-flapped door, revelers will find one of 12 flavors of gourmet caramel from the famed Massachusetts confectioner.

The world of caramels involves more than just butter and sugar. To offer more variety to those with a sweet tooth, the McCrea’s Caramel Advent Calendar packs a dozen different flavors of caramel behind its 24 doors. The flavors range from the traditional Classic Vanilla, Chocolate Orange, Christmas Plum, and Gingerbread to the intriguing Black Lava Sea Salt, so you’ll have plenty of opportunity to pick a favorite. And this year’s packaging features dreamy artwork of a kitty family by Boston-based artist Angellize Rivera.

### La Boîte à Bonbons 2026 Advent Calendar

These soft gummy candies from Montreal are fresh and perfectly chewy, and they taste like fruit rather than artificial flavoring.

Canadian candy company La Boîte à Bonbons makes perfectly chewy and pillowy gummies in surprisingly authentic fruit flavors. Each pull-out box in the La Boîte à Bonbons 2026 Advent Calendar contains three to six pieces of sweet or sour soft candies. It’s an unusually generous little handful of berries, worms, fruits, and rings. The numbers of calendars are limited, and this year’s version is likely to sell out. You can order immediately and choose your delivery week from a drop-down menu.

### Dandelion Chocolate 2026 Advent Calendar

These exquisite Advent calendars are designed by a different artist every year. Inside cylindrical boxes are Dandelion chocolate confections reimagined by 25 different chocolatiers.

The Dandelion Chocolate Advent Calendar from this San Francisco–based bean-to-bar chocolate maker is pricey but absolutely stunning. Each little cylinder-shaped box nestled inside doubles as an ornament and contains a confection from a different chocolatier from across North America and Japan, using Dandelion’s chocolate. The selection ranges from ganaches to caramels to candied citrus, and every one is special. “I think it’s worth the price just to sample chocolates from so many great chocolatiers,” said editorial director Marguerite Preston, “but the boxes are also so sturdy and beautiful that you could totally reuse them to make your own Advent calendar in years to come.” And if sharing is just too big an ask, Dandelion also makes a double-portion Advent calendar for two.

### Flaviar Whiskey Advent Calendar 2026

This box includes 24 unlabeled whiskey nips from the world at large alongside two shapely tasting glasses. There’s also a link to an app that asks sippers to rate the day’s sample before revealing its origins.

Wirecutter writer and bourbon fan Thom Dunn has tried a lot of whiskey Advent calendars in his day, but the Flaviar Whiskey Advent Calendar stands out because “it actually sort of teaches you about whiskey.” Each of the 24 mystery bottles, 50 mL in size, is numbered but otherwise nondescript. Tasters sip the day’s whiskey and then rate it on a proprietary app that reveals full details. There’s always at least one very pricey whiskey in the batch, and it’s fun looking back to see how you rated it blindly, compared with your ratings for, say, Jim Beam. Beware: It always sells out.

## Calendars for adults and teens

### Clue Advent Calendar

Each door of this 24-day murder-mystery Advent calendar contains a puzzle to solve, which leads to the door with the next clue. The puzzles take about five to 10 minutes to complete.

If your family revels in solving puzzles together, the engrossing Clue Advent Calendar is a real ride. At the Tudor Mansion on a snowy winter night, six guests arrive at the invitation of their wealthy host, Boddy Black, who is subsequently murdered. To solve this whodunit, the group reads a short story and opens one door to a new puzzle for each of the 24 days. One day might involve using logical deduction to decipher a recipe, while another might ask you to put together a pattern and match it to a door. To find the next door (they are unnumbered), the group needs to solve the day’s puzzle, but there are three hints if you get stumped. We looked forward to the bonding activity every night and had a blast figuring out each brainteaser together.

### Revolve Beauty Advent Calendar

This collection of best-selling products, packed in a sturdy mini suitcase, includes 10 full-size finds alongside a selection of generous minis in a rare beauty Advent calendar bargain.

You’d be hard-pressed to find a better value for a beauty obsessive than the Revolve Beauty Advent Calendar, which pairs 13 full-size best-selling products alongside minis and accessories, with an estimated value of over $950. Highlights include Summer Fridays Dream Lip Oil, Ilia Base Face Milk, Benefit Benetint Lip & Cheek Stain, and Babe Original Essential Lash Serum. There are also hair products, beauty accessories, and wellness gummies. It’s all packaged up in a pink and red, metal-handled suitcase that you could use to store your new loot year-round. Revolve Beauty also sells a 12-day Advent calendar set.

### Anthropologie Beauty Advent Calendar

Packed in an illustrated maroon-hued box, this set includes premium samples, among them Sunday Riley Good Genes, Salt & Stone Santal & Vetiver Deodorant, and Phlur Missing Persons Eau de Parfum.

Beauty Advent calendars abound, but the Anthropologie The 24 Days of Beauty Advent Calendar, fancifully illustrated in maroons and pinks by London-based illustrator Nephthys Foster, is particularly beautiful. Unlike the Revolve calendar, it contains only large samples — not full sizes — but that may be preferable for those who prefer to test before committing any vanity space. The wide-ranging assortment includes scents, skin and hair care, nail products, and makeup. And it features products that may appeal to both Gen Z (Phlur Missing Person fragrance, Celebritips press-on nails) and their parents (Sunday Riley Good Genes, Salt & Stone deodorant). There’s also a 12-day version with a different set of products, including L’Occitane Almond Shower Oil and OPI Funny Bunny Nail Lacquer, for about half the price, but we prefer the assortment in the larger version.

### The McSweeney’s Advent Calendar

A knee-slapper for the erudite, this boxed set includes 24 mini holiday-humor books from the catalog of indie publisher McSweeney’s. It had us literally laughing out loud.

It’s not just the look of The McSweeney's Advent Calendar that we love; it’s the personality. Designed as a diminutive boxed set with illustrations by Sophy Hollington, it contains 24 numbered mini hardback books. Each book is a standalone piece of holiday-adjacent humor writing, comics, letters, poetry, and more from the McSweeney’s world of books, magazines, and online literary publications. This year includes “Isaac Chotiner Interviews Santa Claus,” “Scenes from a Hallmark Hanukkah Movie,” and “Three Kings White Elephant Gift Exchange.” It’s not dirt cheap, but we can’t think of a better way to ring in the season than with beautiful design and a daily guffaw. There are only so many in print, and like almost everything McSweeney’s publishes, it’s sure to become a collector’s item.

### The Met Museum Favorites Advent Countdown

Each magnetic mini puzzle in this Advent calendar features a beloved piece of art from The Met.

Each of the 24 mini magnetic puzzles in The Met Museum Favorites Advent Countdown features an image of a Met classic. Open the flap doors to reveal a tiny paper bag containing the pieces. It might be Leutze’s “Washington Crossing the Delaware,” “The Great Wave off Kanagawa,” a Grecian urn, or Rodin’s “The Thinker.” Each puzzle is about 3 inches when finished. We only wish it included some information about the featured artwork. Note too that if you’ve bought The Met’s puzzle Advent calendar before, this is the same as 2025’s version.

### L’Occitane Beauty Advent Calendars

In this box the high-end Provençal company features 24 days’ worth of beloved beauty classics, including Almond Shower Oil and Shea Butter Hand Cream. Choose from two versions: the more expensive Prestige and the slightly less expensive Classic.

A classic favorite, the L’Occitane Beauty Advent Calendars are highly anticipated every year. Among the many Advent calendars that beauty and personal-care writer Neha Tandon has tested, she says, the luxurious L’Occitane Prestige Advent Calendar seems to be the one that’s really worth its price. “I kept all my favorites and then added the rest onto bigger gifts for loved ones,” she attested. Among her long list of keepers, Neha cited the Immortelle Divine Cream, Overnight Oil Serum, and Amande Sublime Exfoliating Soap. The 24-product sampler features 13 deluxe sizes and a full-size Almond Shower Oil. There’s also a slightly less expensive L’Occitane Classic Advent Calendar, which features less than half as many deluxe versions and no full sizes.

## Kids calendars

### Bluey Advent Calendar

Fans of the dog-family animation series won’t be disappointed with this 24-day Advent calendar, which we think is a great deal for this many “Bluey” figurines.

“What a dream!” enthused editor Signe Brewster, whose 5-year-old and 3-year-old gasped as they opened each door of the Bluey Advent Calendar 2026. Fans of the über-popular Australian animated series are treated to 24 surprises, and Signe reports that the figurines, in particular, are nice, heavyweight, and not destined for the trash. She does note that only her 5-year-old could open the cardboard doors without help, but we consider that a sign of the calendar’s strong construction compared with those that ripped too easily. The only real dings, according to Signe’s children, were that they were confused as to why there were no figurines of the parents, and the stickers were disappointing compared with everything else. But overall, “the girls had a ton of fun with this and are happily playing with the pieces now.”

### National Geographic Mega Science Advent Calendar

Mini experiments, rocks, and fossils provide the perfect, project-based lead-up to Christmas for budding scientists.

It seems like nearly every kid goes through the collecting rocks, crystals, and fossils stage, and for them, we love the boredom-curing Mega Science Advent Calendar. (Bonus points for not being candy, which we’re sure they’ll get plenty of over the season.) It contains 13 easy experiments to make a test tube glow, grow crystals, and float coins, plus 11 treasure-worthy rocks and fossils. But before they even reach December 1, they get to open the protective goggles. Safety first! It’s recommended for kids 8 to 12, and it could be fun as a family project.

### The Woobles Here We Go A-Wooblin’ Advent Calendar

This set contains four kid-friendly crochet projects for crafting roly-poly animals. Instructions are available via a handy QR code.

Our kids team loves the easy, beginner-friendly crochet kits from The Woobles and calls them “virtually idiot-proof.” The Woobles Here We Go A-Wooblin’ Advent Calendar contains four full-size crochet kits, mini projects, and a bunch of hooks, plus crochet accessories, all in cute Christmas-themed boxes tucked into a fold-out-case workshop. Each Woobles kit comes with a QR code for access to video instructions.

### Lego Advent calendars

The 31-piece comic-themed calendar includes festive accessories mixed in with favorite superheroes, such as Captain America wielding a candy cane and Iron Man’s gift-wrapping robot.

Disney Princess fans ages 5 years and over will be thrilled by this building set that features Moana, Mulan, Ariel, and more.

With seven mini-build vehicles and iconic characters in festive dress, this Mandalorian-themed Advent calendar offers family bonding for fans ages 6 and older. Just look at Grogu in his adorable red holiday sweater.

Wirecutter’s staff includes many AFOLs (adult fans of Lego), as well as fans of Lego’s sets for kids. We can quibble about the various merits of individual minifigures or set-design creativity, but we love the Lego Advent calendars because they offer one mini build a day — for adults and kids alike. The build instructions are on the back of the little doors. Editor Hannah Morrill’s 4-year-old son enjoyed the uniqueness of each build — a plane, a helicopter, a launcher — even if they did require a little help with assembly. (Kids even one year older would be fine.)

### Mini Brands Advent Calendar

A little on the pricey side, this 24-day Advent calendar delivers faux food, characters, and more to devotees of the small-scale collectibles.

For many parents, the Mini Brands franchise seems like a cheery assault on the environment, with its parade of wasteful plastic orbs. And that’s part of why we love the Mini Brands Advent Calendar so much. Instead of plastic balls destined for landfills, the calendar delivers adorable minuscule faux food, characters, and other teeny toys. Gifts editor Hannah Morrill’s 8-year-old daughter was thrilled with it. “She says she feels like a YouTube influencer that has all the Mini Brands stuff,” reported Hannah. We only wish it were about half the price. If your mini is mad for minis, this box may scratch the itch for good.

### Playmobil Advent calendars

Collect a winter wonderland of horses, a barn, a sleigh, and other animals with this 24-day advent calendar.

This 84-piece set supplies everything needed to create a European Christmas market, including ice skaters and a booth selling sweets.

Playmobil’s various Advent calendars, marketed for children ages 4 to 10 years old, are always a hit. The Playmobil Advent Calendar Christmas Sleigh Ride is geared toward animal lovers, with a waterfall backdrop and 24 figurines, including a barn, horse, and dog. And the Christmas Market Advent Calendar, with its ice skating rink and holiday treats, seems inspired by Germanic Christmas markets. After the kids collect the daily figurines, the payoff on Christmas morning is a gift in itself — a tableau of trinkets they’ll love to play with all year long. “My brother and I would dutifully take turns with who got to open up the paper window every day during December,” said Wirecutter’s Kelsey Dang. “The attention to detail in the accessories is delightful, and the goal of building out a full scene keeps the suspense going throughout the month.”

## Do-it-yourself Advent calendar

If your favorite Advent calendar is sold out for the season, or you can’t find one that fits your fancy, you can always make your own — with a little help. Customizing and filling a reusable, blank calendar can become a new tradition you’ll look forward to for years to come. Many craft stores sell unpainted, preassembled wooden Advent calendars that you can decorate yourself.

Finished versions like this simple graphic drawer-style calendar abound, as do hanging cloth calendars from the traditional to the understated. (We’re also tempted to try a nightly beer or canned cocktail with this $70 Wisconsin-made tree calendar designed to hold cans.)

Once you’ve got your vessel, it’s on to the fun part of filling it. The makers of some of Wirecutter’s most beloved teas, such as Fortnum & Mason and Kusmi Tea, sell sampler packs, as does scented-candle maker Keap, so you can pop a few into your calendar pockets. We also suggest many small gifts in our guides to stocking stuffers for kids and adults. Other ideas include mini art supplies, socks, hair accessories, lip balm, seed packets, tinned fish, and soaps. Just make sure to take measurements of the drawers or pockets on your calendar before you start shopping for trinkets.

If you prefer something sweet, one of our favorite boxes of chocolate, Melissa Coppel Bonbons, contains 24 colorful pieces — just enough to last until Christmas, if your giftee can wait that long. On the other hand, if you get two boxes of our top pick from Recchiuti Confections, you’ll have eight pieces left over for snacking. Either way, be sure to store your choco-fabulous Advent calendar in a cool, dry environment.

Another highlight of the Christmas Shop is its range of artificial **Christmas trees**. You'll find festive options for every space, from petite tabletop decor to grand pre-lit trees.   + Matching your ornaments to your seasonal decorating theme is a good way to go. Are you dreaming of a white Christmas or going for Santa-themed red and green? The Christmas Shop offers traditional and modern ornaments in every style to complement your overall holiday theme.
